text:
Zara (CS): FYI Morpheus Analytics is asking for a temporary regional burst + allowlist for an executive demo. Renewal discussion in 7 days and they're flagged as "RISK" if demo fails. Request: 36h burst, eu-central-1 + ap-southeast-1, up to 1000 QPS each, and add their proxy CIDRs. Can we schedule with auto-revoke? @Rafael @Maya

Evan (Morpheus): CIDRs: 198.51.100.64/26 and 203.0.113.192/27. Demo window UTC: 2026-04-10T15:00:00Z. We'll keep traffic source-limited to those ranges.

Rafael (EngOps): need org_id/project_id and Hosted vs Dedicated. For Hosted we can route to soft-quota pools with override; Dedicated needs capacity ok. Also recommend a 5% canary for 10m before full ramp.

Maya (SRE): I'll create a temporary dashboard and pager rule. Set alert thresholds: p95_latency > 450ms or error_rate > 2.5% -> page. Also will configure fallback to smaller model if sustained degradation. Need exact auto_revoke timestamp in UTC.

Zara (CS): org_id: morpheus-prod, project_id: exec-demo. Hosted. Auto-revoke: 2026-04-12T15:00:00Z (36h). Ticket CS-13111 attached. High priority.

Rafael (EngOps): prepping YAML to apply after Maya okays alerts. Will include staged ramp and auto_revoke.

Rafael (EngOps): ```yaml
org: morpheus-prod
project: exec-demo
regions:
  - eu-central-1
  - ap-southeast-1
qps_each: 1000
canary: 5% for 10m
allowlisted_cidrs:
  - 198.51.100.64/26
  - 203.0.113.192/27
auto_revoke: 2026-04-12T15:00:00Z
notes: "36h executive demo burst; CS-13111"
```

deploy-bot: Created OPS ticket OPS-10045 to track override and ACL. Link: https://redwood.internal/ops/OPS-10045

Maya (SRE): approved. Canary start 2026-04-10T14:45:00Z UTC. I'll stand by the dashboard and add synthetic pings during warmup.

Rafael (EngOps): applying canary now. Command: `infractl override apply --org morpheus-prod --project exec-demo --file tmp/morpheus-demo-burst.yaml --canary 5%`

deploy-bot: OPS-10045 updated: canary applied by rafael at 2026-04-10T14:46:30Z UTC.

Maya (SRE): canary smoke OK. Rolling to full override at 15:00 UTC. Alerts set and fallback configured: switch to compact-ml if p95>700ms for 20s.

Rafael (EngOps): prod override applied at 2026-04-10T15:00:10Z UTC. Auto-revoke scheduled 2026-04-12T15:00:00Z UTC.

Evan (Morpheus): demo ran. We saw one 30s spike at minute 22 but fallback kept latency under control. Sending perf logs. Appreciate quick help.

Zara (CS): adding demo logs to CS-13111 and updating renewal owner. If steady, we'll discuss committed capacity. Closing thread unless anomalies crop up. :white_check_mark:
